title: When waiting keeps turning bitter in the day as it is
issueStatement: Delay has started feeding resentment instead of ripening trust. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru ties patience to listening, honor, and steadiness rather than passive resentment. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Wait by listening instead of simmering.
actionPrompt: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
